# BIP39 English wordlist notice

`data/bip39_english.txt` is copied from the Bitcoin Improvement Proposals repository at `bip-0039/english.txt` for deterministic validation and public test-vector reproduction.

The BIP39 specification states that it is distributed under the MIT License. The wordlist is included as a third-party standards fixture. This package does not use it to enumerate candidate wallet secrets or target third-party addresses.
